title: Forest Survey Of India
definition: The Forest Survey of India (FSI) is a premier national organization under the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC), responsible for conducting surveys and assessments of the country's forest resources.
importanceInUpsc: FSI reports (ISFR) are the primary data source for Environment questions in Prelims and provide critical evidence for Mains answers on climate change, biodiversity, and sustainable development.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Forest Survey Of India.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
